title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia chief executive after 33 years
summary: Finance chief Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO of the world's most valuable chipmaker.
body:
Jensen Huang has resigned as president and chief executive of Nvidia, the company he co-founded in 1993 and built into the leading maker of chips for artificial intelligence.

Nvidia announced the move on Thursday 12 November in a filing with US regulators. It said the resignation took effect immediately, and that Huang had also left the board. The filing gave no reason for his departure.

Who takes over

Colette Kress, the chief financial officer, has been appointed interim chief executive. Harvey C. Jones has been named chair of the board, the first in the company's history.

Nvidia shares closed down 4.34% on Thursday. The company is due to report its quarterly results on Tuesday 17 November.

Sources: Nvidia's filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, NBC News, The Boston Globe.
